why_it_matters: Special stock indicator. A 541 dispatch posts a vendor row (SOBKZ 'O') and a plant row; without it both are summed and every dispatch quantity doubles. Fails silently. I08 FRS s7.
Line creation date. PurchaseOrderItemSet publishes no date property at all; ERDAT anchors aging, overdue and lead-time comparison, and EKKO has no header row for 37% of repair lines. I08 FRS s7.

Requirement tracking number, Edm.String(10). Designated carrier of the assistant session identifier. Live on PurchaseRequisitionSet and PurchaseOrderItemSet, absent from ReservationItemSet. Hard dependency for I08 FR-8 and FR-4.
Goods recipient, 12 chars. Exposed. Used as the I13 requester proxy (73.2% populated). Candidate session field only if BEDNR is refused.
Item text. Named as a session-field candidate in I08 s10; not in the projection.
Unloading point. Named as a session-field candidate in I08 s10; not in the projection.
Z-append session identifier. I13 s7.2: the single field linking the platform consumption plan to the SAP reservation. Read model carries the placeholder and maps it to null.
Current safety stock. Exposed over OData but absent from the delivered 19-column extract. Without it I07 shows what it recommends but not what SAP holds. I07 FRS s7.
MRP type. THE OAR identifier under the 08-Sep ruling: OAR = DISMM in {ND, PD}. Single most important field in I13. I13 FRS s7.1.
Reorder point. FR-3 comparison and FR-9 adoption tracking.
Max stock. FR-3 comparison and FR-9 adoption tracking.
Planned delivery time. Placeholder lead time until the I11 Z-program lands.
External material group. RETIRED as the OAR identifier (I07 s7 supersession note, I13 s7.3). Informational only now; its absence is no longer BLOCKING and s8/s10 of both FRS should be updated.
Currency. A price with no currency is ambiguous; ZAR is assumed by context, not by data. I07 FRS s7.
PO document date. Not exposed; EKKO.AEDAT is the interim release-date proxy for the I11 lead-time program.
Interim release-date proxy for the release-to-GRN lead time.
Requisition item. Exposed, but check the KEY column below: I07 s10 asks for it to be ADDED TO THE ENTITY KEY so requisition items are uniquely addressable.
PR-to-PO stitching key. 37.6% populated in the extract.
Order number. 39.2% populated; recommended as the next stitching increment (I13 s7.5), roughly thirty times the linkage of the BANFN route and needs no SAP change.
Reservation-to-PR link. Only 1.2% populated - the principal FR-5 obstacle.
Posting date. The single date basis for every movement metric.
Movement type. 201/261 = consumption, 541 = removal to repair (I08).
Transaction/event type. Goods-receipt filter for FR-6; see vgabe_profile.txt.

verdict: I07 s10: add EBAN.BNFPO to the PurchaseRequisitionSet entity key so requisition items are uniquely addressable.
